subject.title: fix: route direct outbound polls through channel adapters

question: Should this PR land with the existing Telegram live proof plus focused shared tests, or should maintainers request broader direct/hybrid poll proof first?
rationale: The implementation is the right owner boundary and proof is positive, but it changes user-visible poll delivery routing across adapter modes, which is a maintainer risk acceptance choice.

options.title: Merge with covered delivery risk
options.body: Accept the Telegram Mantis proof and focused shared tests as sufficient coverage for the direct/hybrid poll routing change.

options.title: Request one more adapter proof
options.body: Ask for an additional live proof on another direct or hybrid poll-capable adapter before merge if broader runtime evidence is desired.

recommendation.title: Merge with covered delivery risk
recommendation.body: Accept the Telegram Mantis proof and focused shared tests as sufficient coverage for the direct/hybrid poll routing change.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned and has the strongest history on outbound poll, target, and plugin-boundary code touched by the PR.
